title: Saudi Arabia nixes key events as Houthi war escalates
gist: A short Al-Monitor podcast listing: Saudi Arabia cancels key events as the Houthi war escalates; Israeli President Herzog meets Azerbaijan's Aliyev amid Baku-Turkey tension; Syria arrests a former pro-Assad militia leader over the 2013 Baniyas massacre.

insights.claim: Israeli President Isaac Herzog met Azerbaijan's President Ilham Aliyev amid tensions between Baku and Turkey.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Israel-Azerbaijan ties are deepening against a Turkey-Azerbaijan strain.

insights.claim: Syrian authorities arrested a former leader of a pro-Assad militia accused of involvement in the 2013 Baniyas massacre.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Saudi Arabia has cancelled key events as the Houthi war escalates, per the episode title.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Event cancellations show war spillover into the Saudi economy.
